storage: Keep whole pods in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard for up to about 1 year. Keep dry; damp pods go mouldy.
looksLike: A large, wrinkled, dark-brown to black pod, about the size of a small olive or bigger, with a strong smoky, camphor-like smell. Much bigger and coarser than green cardamom.
howToPick: General guidance, not from a source in this run: choose dry, plump pods with an intact skin and a smoky, camphor smell; avoid split, mouldy, damp or odourless pods. One pod is enough for a dish.
shelfLife: Whole pods keep for about 1 year in a sealed jar (general guidance).
substitutes: Bay leaf and a pinch of cinnamon

usedIn.raw: 1 pod per serving (lightly crushed; the dish file gives no gram weight)
